title: National Swiss Sarcoma Cohort Study
brief_summary: Registration of all sarcoma patients treated at a specialized sarcoma center in Switzerland.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all primary bone and soft tissue sarcoma defined by th WHO classification 2013

Exclusion Criteria:

* all non- primary sarcomas
* patient's wish
study_population: All patients diagnosed with histo- pathological proven sarcoma
